honest_sentence: £100M Sovereign AI R&D Procurement Scheme: announced Aug 31 2026 at G20 by Chancellor John Healey + AI Minister Kanishka Narayan. 4 first competitions (NHS/Compute/Defence/NCSC). IP retained, upfront payments, demonstrator-stage. G7 cooperation via AI Economics Institute.
